answer: Proof of Stake functions as a Sybil resistance mechanism by requiring agents to lock capital to participate in network validation. An attacker attempting to cultivate an orchard of fake identities must acquire substantial tokens, making the voyage to dominance prohibitively expensive. The barrier to entry creates a dune of financial friction, ensuring that control scales linearly with economic sacrifice rather than by spawning infinite cheap nodes, thus rendering mass identity fraud economically irrational.
